effect_description_eng:
＜Decode (Lv.5 w/[Aquatic]/[DATA SQUAD] trait)＞ (When this Digimon would leave the battle area other than in battle, you may play 1 specified Digimon card from its digivolution cards without paying the cost.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] [Counter] [Once Per Turn] By placing 1 of your other Digimon or Tamers as this Digimon's bottom digivolution card, return 1 of your opponent's Digimon with as many digivolution cards as this Digimon or fewer to the bottom of the deck.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When effects add to this Digimon's digivolution cards, you may play 1 play cost 5 or lower blue card from its digivolution cards without paying the cost.
(Rule) Trait: Has [Aquatic] Type.
